name: Mesh Reindexing
aliases: Mesh Reindexing — Global ID Assignment, Vertex Deduplication via Mapping
definition: Deduplicates vertices stored in a mapping and assigns contiguous global IDs, then constructs the final vertex and index buffers.
summary: Mesh Reindexing deduplicates isosurface vertices by assigning contiguous global IDs to unique points, ensuring shared vertices share indices to prevent redundant geometry.
